title: Process descendant tracking
responsibility: Tracks process identities by PID and start time through parent and anchored process-group observations, and signals only identities that still match.

inputs.name: processDescendants.root
inputs.description: PID of the command whose descendants are tracked. It is established as the root only when a table records this PID and its start time while the tracker is open; PID alone does not establish identity.

inputs.name: processDescendants.read
inputs.description: Process-table callback used by tracking reads; it may return null when the table is unreadable. Defaults to processTable, which runs bounded ps with a five-second timeout.

inputs.name: signalProcesses.known
inputs.description: PID/start-time pairs supplied for an identity check against a fresh process table before signaling. Entries absent from the table, including reused PIDs with a different start time, are left untouched.

inputs.name: signalProcesses.signal
inputs.description: Signal to attempt for each supplied identity that still matches. The accepted values are SIGTERM and SIGKILL.

outputs.name: processTable
outputs.description: Resolves with parsed rows containing only PID, parent PID, process group, and ps start-time text when the bounded ps read completes within 5000 ms and includes this process. Resolves null if the command fails, times out, or its output does not contain this process.

outputs.name: processDescendants
outputs.description: Returns a tracker whose look skips overlaps, whose survivors lists still-existing parent-linked descendants, and whose closed marks the root reaped and performs one more look. alive returns existing owned processes plus group-only strangers marked unproven, or null when the table is unreadable; survivors excludes the root and strangers.

outputs.name: signalProcesses
outputs.description: Resolves after checking a fresh process table when known is nonempty, and attempts the requested signal only for PID/start-time pairs still present. It resolves without signaling when the table is unreadable and ignores process.kill errors.
